newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ishihara Construction plans third-party allocation.
newsitem.headline: Ishihara Construction plans third-party allocation.

text.p: Ishihara Construction Co Ltd said on Thursday it plans to make a third-party share allocation worth 6.2 billion yen on March 25.
The company said in its statement that the move was aimed at improving its financial condition.
The company said it would issue 31 million new shares to five firms, including Misawa Homes Co Ltd.
The funds raised from the allocation will be used to repay loans, the statement said.
The company expects to a post parent current profit of 100 million yen in the current business year ending on March 31, the statement said.
It posted a parent current loss of 1.2 billion yen in the previous business year.
